result.rationale: TPG controlled Olympus by 2024 year-end through Rise Climate private equity/Impact, not Transition Infrastructure. Intrepid's qualifying historical infrastructure interest exited; no qualifying current owner was found.
result.identityResolution: Olympus Terminals LLC is Chemoil Terminals LLC renamed in 2021; HQ: Long Beach, CA; website: https://olympusterminals.com/. Count once; all sites, tanks, docks, pipelines, projects and holdcos are subordinate.

ownershipResolution.otherOwner: Pilot Travel Centers LLC joined in 2021; current status is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED and nonqualifying.
ownershipResolution.qualification: Intrepid Energy Infrastructure historically qualified; TPG's deal is not Transition Infrastructure; no DK deal-linked infrastructure mandate was proven.

result.operatingResolution: Active since 1984. Long Beach: 9 tanks/520,000 barrels and marine access. Carson: 22 tanks plus vapor tank/1,289,000 barrels. Pipelines, racks, blending and vapor systems handle fuels, crude and chemicals.

acquisitionExitCheck.summary: TPG signed May 7, 2024 to acquire control from DK/Intrepid-backed ownership and closed by year-end. Value, security, approvals, vehicle and exact close date are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED; no DK/Intrepid retention was evidenced.
acquisitionExitCheck.later: Holdco II first-lien debt maturing in 2030 was reported at year-end 2024; no later equity transfer, asset sale, sponsor exit or signed pending deal was found.

milestones.event: DK-majority/Pilot/Intrepid group acquired Chemoil and renamed it Olympus.
TPG announced May 7 and closed control by year-end.
